info.title: Continuum AI Task internal API — DATN-97 seven-field slice
info.description: Contract for the DATN-97 (D-05) seven-field Task slice: list by Project and detail only, APPROVED for those two operations by the Leader on 19/10/2026 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#issuecomment-6263376181). Scope follows the Leader's partial approval of the Document D05-DR1 decision request (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/Document/pull/44#issuecomment-6248155568), recorded in Document doc 25 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/Document/pull/46): DR-1/2/4/5/6/7(a)(b) approved by the Leader, who confirmed on 19/10/2026 that he exercises the Product, Architecture and Security authority for this slice (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/Document/pull/46#issuecomment-6258355860). Create is deliberately omitted until DR-7(c)(d) is recorded; no mutation, status, assignment, filter, sort, history or Idempotency-Key exists in this slice. These are internal Task-service routes, disabled by default, behind the deny-by-default authorization boundary; DR-3 (trust profile) and DR-8 (scope evidence) are DEFER, so no route may be activated from this contract. A task exposes exactly id, projectId, title, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt and version. version is informational and is not a CAS/ETag. Choices recorded by the task owner are listed in x-owner-decisions; items still waiting for others are listed in x-pending-decisions.

x-approval-status: APPROVED for the list and detail operations of the seven-field slice by the Leader on 19/10/2026 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#issuecomment-6263376181), within the conditions in x-approval-conditions. Create, DR-3, DR-7(c)(d), DR-8 and AUTH-1 are not approved. After that approval the reviewer's change request of 20/10/2026 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#pullrequestreview-5579678413) added ERR-2, HDR-1, CACHE-2 and STATUS-1 to x-owner-decisions; the Leader has not repeated the approval for those additions.
x-approval-conditions: Reviewed revision: the list and detail contract of DATN-BE PR #55 as it stood when the Leader approved it on 19/10/2026 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#issuecomment-6263376181). Commit ids of the PR branch are not cited because a squash merge removes them.
The approval applies only to the list and detail APIs and the seven-field Task structure in the reviewed revision.
DR-4 stays as approved: Organization Membership and ProjectMembership must both be ACTIVE; members read the Tasks of their own Project; no Events.
DR-3, DR-7(c)(d) and DR-8 stay DEFER.
AUTH-1 is not approved for the trust profile, the service identity or the real scope evidence.
No route activation, production use or policy ALLOW until the related security conditions are completed.
The create API is not part of this approved OpenAPI.
The handler must map the authorization denial reason to 401, 404 or 503 and must not answer a generic 403 (ERR-1).
x-decision-refs: DR-1 A, DR-2 A, DR-4 (whole-Project read for ACTIVE members, no Events), DR-5, DR-6 A, DR-7(a)(b) approved; authority confirmed by the Leader on 19/10/2026: https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/Document/pull/46#issuecomment-6258355860
OpenAPI approval for list and detail (PATH-1, LIMIT-1, CURSOR-1, ERR-1, CACHE-1 approved; create out of scope): https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#issuecomment-6263376181
Reviewer change request on this contract (ERR-2, HDR-1, CACHE-2, STATUS-1), 20/10/2026: https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#pullrequestreview-5579678413
x-owner-decisions: SOURCE: recorded by the task owner at the Leader's request in the review of DATN-BE PR #55 (19/10/2026 02:28Z). The Leader approved these decisions on 19/10/2026 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#issuecomment-6263376181).

PATH-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 19/10/2026): keep /internal/tasks/projects/{projectId}/tasks[/{taskId}]. It keeps the approved /internal/tasks prefix and gives the existing TaskAuthorizationHttpGuard a project path parameter and a detail resource parameter.
LIMIT-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 19/10/2026): the default limit is 20; DR-6 fixes the 1-100 range.

CURSOR-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 19/10/2026): nextAfterId is the id of the last item when the page is full (items.length equals limit) and null otherwise, so a client may receive one empty final page; no repository change.

ERR-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 19/10/2026): authorization denial reasons map to 401 (unverified credential), 404 (non-member, cross-scope, Project or resource mismatch, denied permission, malformed path id) and 503 (scope evidence or permission policy unavailable); a malformed limit or afterId returns 422; authorization runs before input validation; the error codes are TASK_UNAUTHENTICATED, TASK_NOT_FOUND, TASK_VALIDATION_FAILED and TASK_AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE. DR-5 approved by the Leader covers only 404 for non-member and cross-scope access. Implementation precondition: the existing TaskAuthorizationHttpGuard returns a boolean and drops the denial reason (Nest would answer a generic 403), so the handler pull request must add a reason-aware mapping to 401, 404 and 503.
CACHE-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 19/10/2026): Cache-Control no-store on 200 responses.

SOURCE-2: the entries ERR-2, HDR-1, CACHE-2 and STATUS-1 were requested by the reviewer kudotruong212 (Dang Van Cong Danh) in the change-request review of DATN-BE PR #55 on 20/10/2026 (https://github.com/DATN-SPRING2027/DATN-BE/pull/55#pullrequestreview-5579678413) and are recorded by the task owner. They complete or tighten ERR-1 and CACHE-1; the Leader's approval of 19/10/2026 covers those two as written and has not been repeated for these additions. They allow no route activation, production use or policy ALLOW (see x-approval-conditions).

ERR-2 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 20/10/2026; requested by the reviewer): complete mapping of the denial reasons of TaskAuthorizationBoundary, which ERR-1 did not name in full. UNVERIFIED_CONTEXT, and a missing or malformed bearer credential, map to 401. PROJECT_MISMATCH, RESOURCE_SCOPE_MISMATCH, PROJECT_SCOPE_DENIED, PERMISSION_DENIED and RESOURCE_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED map to 404; RESOURCE_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED means only that the Task does not exist or its id is malformed. PROJECT_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE and RESOURCE_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE map to 503. RESOURCE_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE is a new reason for a failed Task ownership lookup: the handler pull request must split the resolver result into not found and unavailable, so that a persistence failure is never reported as a missing Task. INVALID_REQUEST means the internal authorization request built by the guard is malformed; it is a server fault, maps to a generic 500 with no reason echoed to the caller and is logged internally, and is never reported as 404. The guard must throw typed errors for every case so that none becomes false and a generic 403. Contract and handler tests must cover every branch.

HDR-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 20/10/2026; requested by the reviewer): every 401 response carries the header WWW-Authenticate: Bearer, as RFC 9110 section 15.5.2 requires. The body keeps the agreed error shape and exposes no token or profile detail.

CACHE-2 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 20/10/2026; requested by the reviewer): Cache-Control no-store applies to every response of both routes, errors included (200, 401, 404, 422, 500 and 503). A 404 can otherwise be cached heuristically, and a cached authorization error could outlive a membership change. This extends CACHE-1.

STATUS-1 (task owner Nguyen Hong Phuc, 20/10/2026; requested by the reviewer): since the lifecycle database contract (DATN-BE PR #58), list and detail return every Task of a Project the caller may read, including CANCELLED and every other lifecycle status. There is no implicit status filter in this slice, and the response keeps exactly the seven approved fields, without status.
x-pending-decisions: AUTH-1: the bearer credential is an opaque verifier input; issuer, audience, token format and service identity (mTLS) are DR-3 and are not specified here. The scope-evidence source and revocation handling are DR-8 and are not specified here.

tags.name: Task slice
tags.description: Internal Task-service routes for the DATN-97 seven-field slice. Disabled by default.

get.summary: List Tasks of one Project (cursor pagination)
get.description: Per DR-4 (approved by the Leader): an ACTIVE Organization Membership and an ACTIVE ProjectMembership may list every Task of the Project they belong to (reading the whole Project is intentional for this slice; no Events, no access to other Projects); both are validated server-side. DR-6: cursor pagination, limit 1-100, ordered by _id ascending; there is no page, total, filter or sort parameter. Authorization runs before input validation, and only limit and afterId are validated afterwards (422). Non-member and cross-scope callers receive 404 (DR-5); a malformed projectId and a denied permission also receive 404 (task-owner decision ERR-1). Every Task of the Project is returned, including CANCELLED and any other lifecycle status; there is no implicit status filter and the response has no status field (STATUS-1).

200.description: One page of Tasks in _id ascending order.

get.summary: Get one Task of a Project
get.description: Per DR-4 and covered by DR-5 for non-member and cross-scope access, as for the list route. The lookup is always bound to both projectId and taskId, so a Task of another Project is indistinguishable from a missing Task and returns 404. A malformed projectId or taskId is also reported as 404 because authorization runs first and there are no other inputs to validate, so this route has no 422. A Task is returned whatever its lifecycle status, including CANCELLED, and the response has no status field (STATUS-1).

taskDelegationBearer.description: Opaque delegated-context credential from the trusted caller, treated as a verifier input. Its profile and the service identity are DR-3 (DEFER) and are not defined by this contract. Browser-supplied actor or Project headers are never identity proof.

ProjectId.name: projectId
ProjectId.description: Project id. It must match the Project bound in the verified context; a mismatch or a malformed value is reported as 404.

TaskId.name: taskId
TaskId.description: Task id. A malformed value is reported as 404.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (DR-6). The default of 20 is a task-owner decision (x-owner-decisions LIMIT-1).

AfterId.name: afterId
AfterId.description: Return Tasks with _id greater than this id. Use the nextAfterId of the previous page.

Unauthenticated.description: The credential is missing, malformed or cannot be verified (authorization denial UNVERIFIED_CONTEXT). The response carries WWW-Authenticate: Bearer (RFC 9110 section 15.5.2, owner decision HDR-1) and exposes no token or profile detail. Profile details are DR-3.

NotFound.description: The Task or Project does not exist or is not visible to the caller. Non-member and cross-scope access (including a Project or resource mismatch) return this response without revealing existence (DR-5). A denied permission and a malformed path id also return it (task-owner decision ERR-1, recorded on 19/10/2026); DR-5 itself covers only non-member and cross-scope access. A Task that does not exist (RESOURCE_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED) returns it as well, but a failed Task ownership lookup does not: that is a 503 (ERR-2). Like every response of these routes it is Cache-Control: no-store (CACHE-2).

ValidationFailed.description: A query value of the list route is malformed: limit is not an integer from 1 to 100, or afterId is not a 24-character hexadecimal id. Returned only after authorization succeeds. A malformed projectId or taskId path value is not reported here: it reaches authorization first and is returned as 404, indistinguishable from a missing resource.

messages: limit must not be greater than 100

AuthorizationUnavailable.description: Project scope evidence, the permission policy or the Task ownership lookup is unavailable (PROJECT_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE, RESOURCE_SCOPE_UNAVAILABLE; owner decision ERR-2). A persistence failure is never reported as a missing Task. The request fails closed; internal topology and credentials are omitted. The evidence source is DR-8.

InternalError.description: The operation failed unexpectedly, or the internal authorization request built by the guard was malformed (INVALID_REQUEST, owner decision ERR-2). The reason is logged internally and never echoed. The response contains no database details, stack trace, topology or credentials.

Task.description: The approved D-03 seven-field Task. No status, priority, assignee, team, dueDate, tags or description exists in this slice.

title.description: The original string as stored. No business length cap and no normalization (doc 22 P2, DR-7(b)); existing BSON size limits apply.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC. The time of the last change to the Task and never earlier than createdAt. It equals createdAt for a Task that has not changed since creation.

version.description: Informational document version, an integer of at least 1. It is 1 at creation and the stored value may be greater than 1 after later changes allowed by the lifecycle database contract (DATN-BE PR #58). It is not a CAS/ETag and there is no expectedVersion in this slice (DR-1).

nextAfterId.description: Id of the last item when the page is full, otherwise null. See x-owner-decisions CURSOR-1.

ErrorResponse.description: The existing backend error shape produced by StructuredExceptionFilter (DR-5).

details.description: Machine-readable context. Use an empty object when no additional context is safe to expose.
